title.value: Run multi-stage PR reviews with parallel sub-agents

introduction.value: A Claude Code plugin that reviews pull requests in stages with sub-agents and validation passes, with optional ensemble review via Codex.

method.value: The /adamsreview:review command runs up to seven parallel sub-agent lenses (correctness, security, UX and others) on a branch or PR. Their findings go through dedup, a cheap-then-deep validation gate, and an optional Opus cross-cutting pass. With --ensemble it adds a Codex pass and a scrape of PR bot comments. /adamsreview:fix then runs fix sub-agents in parallel, re-reviews with Opus, reverts regressions and commits the rest. /adamsreview:walkthrough lets a person decide on uncertain findings.

outcome.value: The author reports, anecdotally on their own PRs (n=me), that it catches far more real bugs than /review, /ultrareview, CodeRabbit, Greptile and Codex review, with fewer false positives. No measured numbers are given.

notes.value: --ensemble costs more tokens and needs the Codex Claude Code plugin. Runs on a regular Claude Code subscription (Max recommended), not Extra Usage credits like /ultrareview.

source_text.body:
Run multi-stage PR reviews with parallel sub-agents
A Claude Code plugin that reviews pull requests in stages with sub-agents and validation passes, with optional ensemble review via Codex.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
CX
Codex
What they did
The /adamsreview:review command runs up to seven parallel sub-agent lenses (correctness, security, UX and others) on a branch or PR. Their findings go through dedup, a cheap-then-deep validation gate, and an optional Opus cross-cutting pass. With --ensemble it adds a Codex pass and a scrape of PR bot comments. /adamsreview:fix then runs fix sub-agents in parallel, re-reviews with Opus, reverts regressions and commits the rest. /adamsreview:walkthrough lets a person decide on uncertain findings.
How it went
The author reports, anecdotally on their own PRs (n=me), that it catches far more real bugs than /review, /ultrareview, CodeRabbit, Greptile and Codex review, with fewer false positives. No measured numbers are given.
Worth knowing
--ensemble costs more tokens and needs the Codex Claude Code plugin. Runs on a regular Claude Code subscription (Max recommended), not Extra Usage credits like /ultrareview.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Review the pull request at [PR URL or branch name] in stages: use separate sub-agents to check correctness, security, tests, and style, then run a validation pass that discards findings you can't back up with a specific line of code. Finish with one ranked list of issues, each with file, line, and a suggested fix. Don't post any comments to the PR; just show me the list.
Original source: https://github.com/adamjgmiller/adamsreview
